name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and manages Nginx for three virtual hosts, including site configurations, document roots, SSL certificates, security headers, fail2ban, firewall rules, sysctl hardening, and SSH restrictions.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication, runtime and log directories, service enablement, and managed Redis configuration.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs Python and PostgreSQL prerequisites, deploys the FastAPI application with its dependencies and virtual environment, provisions the database, and runs the application under systemd on port 8000.
